overview_description.description: Daleel is an AI-native real estate intelligence platform built for the GCC property market. It combines government transaction records, rental data, mortgage information, and live property listings into a unified intelligence layer. The platform helps buyers, investors, brokers, and developers make data-driven real estate decisions through conversational AI and advanced market analytics.
